svg.title: Locking an owner and the other owner's approval
svg.desc: An owner asks to lock the other owner and confirms with a code. If approvals are on and both owners are active, the other owner must approve a risky action first. Without approvals the lock goes through at once. A locked owner is signed out and cannot sign in until unlocked.
